\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{محتاط} (mohtāt)}{محتاط (mohtāt)}]{\ur{محتاط} (mohtāt) — careful; cautious}

\label{lesson:UR-C536-mohtat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for an astrologer, then the Urdu for a horoscope.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{محتاط}}
\textbf{\ur{محتاط}} — \emph{mohtāt} — \textquotedblleft{}careful; cautious\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{محتاط} \ur{ہوتے} \ur{تو} \ur{یہ} \ur{حادثہ} \ur{نہ} \ur{ہوتا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp mohtāt hote to yih hādsā na hotā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you had been careful, this accident would not have happened.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{محتاط}} (\emph{mohtāt}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{muḥtāṭ}, \textquotedblleft{}on one's guard\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mohtāt}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mohtāt}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar āp mohtāt hote to yih hādsā na hotā.} — If you had been careful, this accident would not have happened.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for an astrologer, then the Urdu for a horoscope, then say \emph{mohtāt} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{محتاط} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Careful; cautious\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{چوکنا} (chaukannā)}{چوکنا (chaukannā)}]{\ur{چوکنا} (chaukannā) — alert; on guard}

\label{lesson:UR-C536-chaukanna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a horoscope, then the Urdu for cautious.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{چوکنا}}
\textbf{\ur{چوکنا}} — \emph{chaukannā} — \textquotedblleft{}alert; on guard\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{کھلاڑی} \ur{چوکنا} \ur{ہے} \ur{تو} \ur{گیند} \ur{نہیں} \ur{چھوٹے} \ur{گی۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar khilāṛī chaukannā hai to gend nahīṅ chhūṭe gī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the player is alert, the ball won't slip past him.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{چوکنا}} (\emph{chaukannā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{caukannā}, \textquotedblleft{}vigilant\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{catuṣkarṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}heard by four ears\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4630): with both ears pricked up.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{انتباہ} (intibāh)}{انتباہ (intibāh)}]{\ur{انتباہ} (intibāh) — a warning}

\label{lesson:UR-C536-intibah}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for cautious, then the Urdu for alert.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{انتباہ}}
\textbf{\ur{انتباہ}} — \emph{intibāh} — \textquotedblleft{}a warning\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{انتباہ} \ur{ملا} \ur{تو} \ur{ہم} \ur{سفر} \ur{نہیں} \ur{کریں} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\textbf{\ur{انتباہ}} (\emph{intibāh}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{intibāh}, \textquotedblleft{}waking up, attention\textquotedblright{}.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{آڑ} (āṛ)}{آڑ (āṛ)}]{\ur{آڑ} (āṛ) — cover (to shelter behind)}

\label{lesson:UR-C536-ar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for alert, then the Urdu for a warning.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{آڑ}}
\textbf{\ur{آڑ}} — \emph{āṛ} — \textquotedblleft{}cover (to shelter behind)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{بارش} \ur{ہوئی} \ur{تو} \ur{ہم} \ur{درخت} \ur{کی} \ur{آڑ} \ur{لیں} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar bārish huī to ham darakht kī āṛ leṅ ge.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

Feminine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{آڑ}} (\emph{āṛ}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{āṛ}, \textquotedblleft{}an interruption, a covering\textquotedblright{}, under \emph{*aḍḍ}, \textquotedblleft{}obstruct\textquotedblright{}, a form it reconstructs (CDIAL 188).
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for saying what happens if.
